title: Thyroid Hormones T3 and T4 as Central Regulators of Basal Metabolic Rate: Molecular Mechanisms, Metabolic Integration, and Therapeutic Potential
description: A comprehensive review of the molecular mechanisms, metabolic integration, and therapeutic potential of thyroid hormones T3 and T4 in regulating basal metabolic rate and treating metabolic diseases.
audience: Researchers, scientists, and drug development professionals
